notes:
• Driver vehicle step: single-tile types share one row; new app screenshots on the landing page; version M2.0.208, W1.3.80
• Driver onboarding fixes: licence/RC back side required, rejected documents block submit, no auto-resubmit on upload, status guards; version M2.0.207
• New app icons for the driver and passenger apps on Android and iOS; version M2.0.204
• Driver vehicle step: fresh vehicle types and categories, plain types in one grid, SVG icons on iOS
• Driver: picking a car category no longer ticks Van too; iOS compile-review fixes
• New driver and passenger logos on Android and iOS; version M2.0.202
• New Gramob logo in the driver and passenger apps, admin, landing site and favicons: the orange tile with the pin G ("D" on the driver app, "P" on the passenger app) beside "GRAMOB" replaces the stacked G mark, wordmark and slogan; on orange grounds the tile shows white with an orange G, and on the dark landing header and footer the name is white; the apps use app-sized copies with a transparent ground (full-size art kept in apps/driver/branding and apps/passenger/branding), the driver online/offline notification shows the new tile, the driver intro no longer shows "Drive Earn Grow" under the logo; admin and landing get new favicons (SVG plus 16-256 px PNG/ICO); the phone home-screen app icon is unchanged; version W1.3.70 / M2.0.201
• Internet calls between passenger and driver: the existing Call buttons (passenger On the way, In progress, Scheduled ride; driver Go to pickup, Active ride, Requests, Scheduled ride detail) now ring the other person's Gramob app over the internet — WebRTC audio, signalled on a new /calls Socket.IO namespace, with STUN/TURN from the API and an FCM push (INCOMING_CALL / CALL_ENDED, 30 s lifetime) for a closed or locked phone; button placement and visibility unchanged, and "Call by phone" (the dialler) is offered when the internet call cannot go through
